chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, from Is'hāq ibn Ibrahim, from Ibn Rashid, from his father, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'A man should not have intercourse with his wife or his slave girl while a child is in the room, for that is from what begets adultery.'
ai.seo_question: Why should a man avoid having intercourse with his wife in the presence of a child according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) warns against sexual intercourse in the presence of a child, linking it to the potential development of 'zina' (adultery) or premature sexual awareness. This teaching highlights the Shia emphasis on modesty (haya) and the psychological impact of parental intimacy on offspring, suggesting that early exposure can normalize sexual behavior outside of proper marital bounds.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al Jowhary, from is’haq Bin Ibrahim, from Ibn Rashid, from his father who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The man should neither sleep with his wife nor with his slave girl whilst in the room is a child (who is awake), for that is from what the adultery is inherited’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from af-Qasim ibn Muhammad af-Jawhariy from Ishaq ibn Ibrahim from ibn Rashid from his father who has said the following: “
Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘A man with his wife must not go to bed in a house where a child exits because it leads to fornication.
